delta.note: The DTP equals the PPh 21 due of each period (non-negative in the final period) for eligible permanent employees; the income criterion is read from the first employment month of 2025 (January for employees already working), using base salary, fixed allowances and regular taxable benefits; employer KLU, NPWP/NIK and other-DTP status are read from case attributes. The refund rule limits year-end refunds to tax actually borne by the employee, so excess DTP is not refunded.

output.reason: PMK 10/2025 grants a government-borne PPh 21 (DTP) facility for certain permanent employees with fixed regular gross income not exceeding Rp10,000,000 who work for employers in labour-intensive industries (footwear, textiles and apparel, furniture, leather) with KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. The facility covers tax periods January–December 2025. The DTP amount is paid in cash to the employee and is not treated as taxable income. Any excess over the annual tax due is not refunded. This changes the PPh 21 outcome and treatment for qualifying permanent employees.
